project0.title: Real-Time Big Data System for Bank Deposit
project0.description: In a team of three, I took the lead in developing a big data system that used Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming and built a predictive model to determine the likelihood of bank customers opening a deposit account. My role involved designing the entire data pipeline, integrating Kafka for data streaming, preprocessing the data, and building the predictive model using machine learning techniques. The solution was implemented as a web application, allowing users to input customer data directly and instantly receive a prediction on whether the customer was likely to open a deposit account.

project1.title: Ketika Bumi Bercerita Infographic
project1.description: I collaborated with my team on a national-level data visualization competition, HI-TECH 7 competition organized by Politeknik Caltex Riau, where we proudly secured 2nd place. This project aimed to raise public awareness about climate change by transforming complex environmental data into compelling, easy-to-understand visual narratives. I led the data analysis using Power BI to uncover key insights and translated those findings into impactful infographics using Canva. This project was a blend of analytical thinking and creative communication, designed to drive climate action through accessible and engaging data visualization.

project2.title: Exploratory Data Analysis of Regional Transfer Fund Effectiveness
project2.description:
This project is a comparative study of the ceiling and realization of Regional Transfer Funds (TKDD) in Indonesian provinces in 2023. Data analysis was conducted through several key stages:

1. Data Preparation: Loading datasets and performing initial understanding of data structure, as well as generating descriptive statistics.
2.  Data Cleaning: Identifying and handling missing values and data duplication, including imputation using the median based on geographical proximity.
3.  Initial Data Visualization: Creating visualizations such as histograms and boxplots to understand data distribution, detect skewness, and outliers.
4.  Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Performing comparisons between TKDD ceilings and realizations, classifying realization percentages, identifying provinces with the highest and lowest realizations, and analyzing factors influencing TKDD realization and the Human Development Index (HDI). This also includes analyzing the relationship between TKDD realization and HDI.
5.  Recommendation Formulation: Presenting key insights from the analysis and providing policy recommendations to improve the effectiveness of budget allocation and implementation.

The main goal of this analysis is to provide in-depth understanding of fund distribution effectiveness and a basis for policy recommendations.

project3.title: Adidas Sales Performance Dashboard
project3.description:
This Power BI dashboard visualizes Adidas sales data in the United States using a dataset from Kaggle, covering the period from January 2020 to December 2021. The interactive dashboard showcases key insights such as total sales and profit, monthly trends in sales and profit, top-selling product categories and more.

Users can dynamically explore the data using slicers for year, month, city, retailer, and product, enabling tailored analysis. Through this project, I honed my skills in data analysis, DAX calculations, and dashboard design, which helped strengthen both my technical BI abilities and analytical thinking.

project4.title: Customer Satisfaction Analysis of Qatar Airways Infographic
project4.description: Infographic presenting data-driven analysis of customer satisfaction with Qatar Airways. Using Python, I explored flight ratings, common complaints, service feedback, and more to uncover key patterns in passenger experience. The visuals highlight which routes receive the highest praise, what aspects customers frequently complain about, and how satisfaction varies across classes. This infographic turns raw data into clear insights that reflect the voice of Qatar Airways passengers.

projec5.title: Netflix Simulation Database
projec5.description: In this project, I led a team of three to build a simulated Netflix-style database using phpMyAdmin. I took charge of designing the Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD) and guiding the creation of key tables like Users, Movies, Genres, Subscriptions, and more. Through this project, I learned how to write SQL queries to input, retrieve and combine data from multiple tables, as well as how to manage and explore relational data effectively.

project6.title: Fitlog Running App
project6.description: I developed a mobile-app called FitLog with my two teammates. The app serves as a daily running diary, allowing users to log their running distance, calories burned, and more. In this project, I was responsible for the UI/UX design—starting from creating the user interface layout to implementing it on the frontend using Android Studio and Java.

publication1.title: Predictive Modeling of School Participation (APS) for Ages 19–23 in Indonesia
publication1.description: In this project, I analyzed the factors affecting Angka Partisipasi Sekolah (APS) among Indonesians aged 19–23 using data mining techniques. I built regression and decision tree models using data from BPS to explore variables such as unemployment, poverty levels, GDP per capita, and more. I worked on data preparation and built prediction models with good accuracy (RMSE: 2.16, R²: 0.85). This project taught me how to uncover key insights from socioeconomic data and build predictive models to support education policy planning.
